frase_clave: Receive your sight. Your faith has healed you.
reflexion: Even if the world's noise tries to drown out your prayer, the Lord always hears your cry. Bring Him your blindness in faith today: what do you need Him to heal in you?

escenas.descripcion: A poor blind beggar sits by the dusty roadside outside Jericho, crying out passionately towards the passing crowd.
Jesus stands gently before the blind man, looking into his face with deep compassion and tenderly reaching out to him.
The man, now seeing clearly, rejoices with arms lifted towards heaven as he follows Jesus amidst a celebrating crowd.

titulo: A reading from the holy Gospel according to Luke.
texto_evangelio: At that time, as he came near Jericho, a certain blind man sat by the road, begging. Hearing a multitude going by, he asked what this meant. They told him that Jesus of Nazareth was passing by. He cried out, “Jesus, you son of David, have mercy on me!” Those who led the way rebuked him, that he should be quiet; but he cried out all the more, “You son of David, have mercy on me!” Standing still, Jesus commanded him to be brought to him. When he had come near, he asked him, “What do you want me to do?” He said, “Lord, that I may see again.” Jesus said to him, “Receive your sight. Your faith has healed you.” Immediately he received his sight and followed him, glorifying God. All the people, when they saw it, praised God.

fragmentos.texto: A reading from the holy Gospel according to Luke.

At that time, as he came near Jericho, a certain blind man sat by the road, begging. Hearing a multitude going by, he asked what this meant. They told him that Jesus of Nazareth was passing by. He cried out,
“Jesus, you son of David, have mercy on me!”
Those who led the way rebuked him, that he should be quiet; but he cried out all the more,
“You son of David, have mercy on me!”
Standing still, Jesus commanded him to be brought to him. When he had come near, he asked him,
“What do you want me to do?”
“Receive your sight. Your faith has healed you.”
Immediately he received his sight and followed him, glorifying God. All the people, when they saw it, praised God.
Even if the world's noise tries to drown out your prayer, the Lord always hears your cry. Bring Him your blindness in faith today: what do you need Him to heal in you?
